title: File the feature-close letter with its architecture, behaviour and usage sections
action: D14: the feature-close letter is in scope — the SAME record shape carrying the extra architecture, behaviour and usage sections D7 names. D7 already promises those three appear only in the feature-close letter and never in the nightly one, so this cell makes an existing promise true rather than inventing a shape. Same file, same frontmatter, same filename rule, same authorship ban: composition may reorder, group and drop, and may never state a fact no stored entry carries. A weekly digest is explicitly out of scope.

The feature-close letter carries the extra architecture, behaviour and usage sections (D7, D14).
Those three sections appear ONLY in the feature-close letter and never in a nightly run letter (D7).
An empty extra section is dropped rather than printed empty, exactly as the five nightly sections are (D7).
Composition still states no fact no stored entry carries — the authorship ban test must pass unweakened (D8).
A weekly digest is not built (D14).
The feature-close stop reaches the append hook by the route hm-2 recorded — close.rs run_close, on the non-dry-run tail only, so a --dry-run appends nothing.

acceptance: Closing a feature files one letter in the same shape carrying architecture, behaviour and usage; those sections never appear in a nightly letter; empty ones are dropped; a --dry-run close appends and files nothing; the authorship ban test passes unweakened.
